1.title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Live walkthrough of separating agent concerns (memory, tools, scaling, observability) into independently scalable infrastructure components, with a concrete CLI example showing how configuration replaces agent code.

1.title: Speech-to-Speech Model Research at Google DeepMind — Valeria Wu Fon & Tom Ouyang, Google DeepMind
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Speech-to-speech models trained end-to-end on multimodal data (audio, video, text) can preserve domain-specific terminology and intonation without explicit rules — and the field faces a three-way tension between latency, task intelligence, and multimodal input that can't be solved by turning up one knob.

2.title: Unlocking the Business of Brand Deals on YouTube /w @hopescope
2.author: Creator Insider
2.hook: YouTube senior director and 8M-subscriber creator break down how automated midrolls, dynamic brand segments, and creator-brand matching actually work — with specific monetization mechanics.

3.title: Voice Agents Can Just Do Things — Charlie Guo, OpenAI
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Speech-to-action (voice triggering tool calls) is the neglected mode; your app's existing endpoints convert directly into tools a voice model can call.
